events.venue: Multiple venues — Blockhouse Hill, Opera House, churches, Wharf Stage
events.description: Nova Scotia's longest-running folk music festival. 4 days, 7 intimate venues, all walkable. Headliners include Sarah Harmer, Colin Linden, Grace Petrie, Danny Michel, Morgan Toney, Ndidi O, and many more. Workshops, concerts, circles, and Main Stage evening shows. Festival pass $190. Youth 25 and under half price.
